formula: sigma_dec(d_perp)=integral d^2b [1-cos(chi(b)-chi(b+d_perp))], averaged over incident directions
assumptions: straight-line eikonal phase screen, uniform B-L sphere
same fixed incoming population and products
heavy 1-GeV mediator phase omitted as negligible in this macroscopic screen
limitations: not an exact partial-wave solution or full eikonal error bound
heavy phase omission not included in a rigorous total error budget
no external coupling constraints, environment or underground transport
constant separation during hold, not full branch history
